about: I studied a Bachelor's in Computer Technology at the University of Bergen and am now continuing with a joint Master's in Software Engineering. I like the mix of big-picture thinking and small details in software: architecture, backend logic, UX, and developer workflow. I'm drawn to the Unix philosophy where it fits: small tools that do one thing well and compose cleanly. Most of my current curiosity goes toward applied AI: agentic systems, LLM harnesses, and retrieval-augmented generation. It's still an area I'm learning, and one I expect to keep expanding into as I use it more. Day to day I work in Neovim on NixOS, and I'm slowly trying to pick up Emacs on the side.
